title: Selections and next-gang override over five complete stays
actions_location: All controls are outside the cabin. No action lies within an uninterrupted stay.
interpretation: Potential whole session assembled independently of detector and controller outputs.
limitations: Temperature/moisture response is derived from measured shapes; this is not a claim that the combined session occurred.
Human door movements label physical actions, not exact proxy-detection times.
Declared thermal history selects the curve before execution. Product output never selects its own environment.

expectations.reason: One explicit start begins one recording; thermostat cycling must not split it.

A lower target already exceeded does not require reheating.
A short empty door event five minutes before real entry must not create a gang.
A full entry with continuing direct presence at sufficient temperature begins a gang.
The closed-door infusion stay is confirmed before the person exits.
An active confirmed gang keeps heating even above the normal thermostat threshold.
The same exit opening, through-ventilation and continuing absence end the gang.
